description: This file defines an abstract base class 'Command' within the 'rialto::servermanager' namespace. The class declares a default constructor, a virtual destructor, deleted copy and move constructors and assignment operators, and a pure virtual method 'run()'. It serves as an interface for command objects in the server manager component.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: An abstract base class representing a command with a pure virtual 'run()' method, intended to be inherited by concrete command implementations.

methods.description: Default constructor for the Command class.

methods.name: ~Command()
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the Command class.

methods.name: run()
methods.description: Pure virtual method that must be implemented by derived classes to execute the command.
